function: CSI compression and feedback: trainable sensing-matrix encoder, learned vector quantization, ISTA-unfolded transformer decoder reconstructing the downlink CSI. p. 2-3.
system: Downlink MIMO-OFDM: BS with 32 elements (4x4 planar, cross-polarized), single-antenna UE, 512 subcarriers, 15.36 MHz; carrier frequency not stated; no RIS. p. 2, 4.
method: QTCS: encoder is one trained matrix-vector product, decoder deep-unfolds ISTA with transformer blocks, learned vector-quantization codebook; end-to-end training with reconstruction and quantization loss. p. 2-3.
data_channel: QuaDRiGa v2.8.1 with 3GPP 38.901 UMi and UMa NLoS configurations, 100 km/h; 5e4 CSI samples. p. 3-4.
test_conditions: UMi and UMa data generated independently, 100 km/h, 60/40 train-test split of 5e4 samples; sweeps of feedback bits and compression ratio; no cross-scenario test. p. 4.
baselines: Non-learned CS: BM3D-AMP, TVAL3D. Learned: CLNet (CNN), SLVit (vision transformer); quantization of QTCS disabled for fair comparison. p. 4.
metrics: NMSE and its CDF per method, versus feedback bits and compression ratio; encoder multiplication count. p. 4.
complexity: Encoder: 2 Lc Na Nt real multiplications (one matrix-vector product), versus O(K^2 Lc Na Nt/s) for CNN and O(Na^2 Nt^2) for attention encoders; decoder cost not reported. p. 4.
openness: none; QuaDRiGa generator is open-source (p. 3) but no code or dataset link is given.
q1_support: p. 3: "The dataset is generated with the most updated open-source channel model Quadriga v2.8.1"; p. 4: "3GPP-38.901-UMi and 3GPP-38.901-UMa" for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 4: "60% are used for training and 40% for testing" - held-out part of the same data; UMi and UMa data are generated independently and no model trained on one is tested on the other.
q3_support: p. 4: "BM3D-AMP and TVAL3D are the conventional CS-based methods, and CLNet and SLVit are the DL-based methods"; all compared on the NMSE CDF in Fig. 3.
q4_support: p. 4: "exactly the 2Lc Na Nt multiplication of real elements" - operation count of the proposed encoder against CNN and attention orders; decoder cost is not reported.
q5_support: p. 4: "The size of the generated CSI data is 5e4" - own generated dataset; QuaDRiGa generator is open-source (p. 3) but no code or generated-dataset link is given.
notes: CSI feedback (area 2); the decoder is a deep unfolding of ISTA with trained parameters, so the method is learned. q1 is 1: QuaDRiGa with 3GPP 38.901 UMi and UMa. q5 is 0 because only the generator is open-source, not the paper's code or dataset; the reviewer may check whether QuaDRiGa generation should count as public data. q4 is 1 on the encoder multiplication count, with the decoder cost missing. Figures read from page images of pages 3 and 4.
